orchestrator.expected_outputs: Exact automatic route for education, recorded spending, disposable income and illustrative savings; completed router and specialist model calls. A mixed spending plus ETF question selects both specialists.
metrics: Observed deployed SHA and test SHA
Exact routing accuracy = matching agent sets / all five planned cases (missing response counts as incorrect).
Micro routing precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), F1 = harmonic mean; absent expected routes count as FN.
acceptance_criteria: Every planned case executes and all declared checks pass (100%).
Real-provider and stable deployment evidence required; absent evidence cannot pass.
All generated synthetic records cleaned up.
Exact routing accuracy, micro precision, recall and F1 all equal 1.0 on this five-case sample.
limitations: Small synthetic dataset, not a production accuracy estimate.
Human semantic assessment remains pending.
No browser login/UI end-to-end coverage.
The deployed application SHA is reported separately; this does not attest undeployed test-branch code.
